o: What's going on all of a sudden?
Is it debt collectors?!
Or did the city inspectors catch you?!
Oh, then you're fine.
If it's not urgent, I'm going to sleep. Figure it out yourself.

chat.t: I-It is urgent! If you come quickly...
I'll give you a week's worth of Tofu Lunchboxes!!

o: Make it two weeks' worth. I'm not taking anything less.
Hey, crying is cheating.
Tsk.
*Sigh*... Can't be helped.
Starting tomorrow, obviously!
How are you going to guard the shop without your friends?

chat.t: But what kind of training is it?

o: Let's leave that as a pleasant surprise for tomorrow.

chat.t: Is it... something weird...? Or, something naughty...?

o: As if. Actually, that does sound tempting.
Just kidding, just kidding.
Just make sure you're not late tomorrow.

lines.t: Tofu Street
You're here, {player}, Master...
What is this mess?
Well, my friends were fighting the GMO Tofu Club inside the shop...
Fighting, and then?
The police a-arrested them.
Huh? They fight all the time, but they suddenly got arrested??
Y-Yes... At first, they tried to talk it out...
But the other side accidentally stepped on some tofu that had spilled onto the floor...
So they started a gunfight right in front of the police and got taken away.
Ah, caught in the act.
Y-Yes!
...But how did you not get arrested?
W-Well...
I didn't shoot a gun myself and just stayed quiet, so the police mistook me for Bystander 1...
That's a relief, at least.
Is... Is it a relief...?
So what happened to the GMO guys?
They fled...
This is the second wave!
H-Hiiik!
Now that the Tofu Troupe isn't here, we're taking over this shop!
Sigh, what an absolute mess this is.

P-Please help me, {player}, Master!
On my own, I can't...

Hey, do you really think me joining in would change anything?
I'm a non-combatant!

Ah, th-then that's okay!
Since I'll do the fighting...

...?
Then what do I do?

Uh... um... Ah! C-Cheer for me!
Give me... the courage to fight...!
Ah, so that's my role.

Go, go! You can do it!
Go, Suji! You got this, Suji!
Y-Yes...!
Urgh, some random nobody is getting in our way...!
Did they always have someone who could fight like that...?!
P-Please leave already!

Dammit!
We won't go easy on you next time!GMO Tofu Club
H-Haa... We barely managed to protect the shop...

Impressive for doing it alone.
I thought you couldn't fight, but that wasn't the case at all.

Anyway, being this timid...
how do you even run a business?
Do bad customers only pick on you, by any chance?
Do customers just completely ignore you when you're at the counter?
H-How did you know?!!

Just had a feeling.
But I guess they don't pick on you when you're fighting?
W-Well, usually when there's a fight, Victoria, Kasa, and Rona are there...

...True.
They don't even see you as a threat.

Yes...
S-So there were times when everyone else was fighting furiously, and I was the only one serving customers...
Am I... really cut out for this tofu business after all?!

Hey, hey.
What does that have to do with selling tofu?
More importantly, how's business? Does the Tofu Troupe have some savings?
S-Savings? Our saved funds are about this much...

What!
That's a ton of money.

T-That's only because we haven't paid our bills yet.
Plus, once we pay for property damage and restock the ruined materials, we'll be in the red.
So you're saying if your friends hadn't caused trouble, you guys would have made a fortune?

Ah, hahaha... Not necessarily...
Since I wouldn't have been able to do any of this on my own...
Still, that's a pretty hefty sum. You can really make this much selling tofu?
Ah... th-that's...
I-It's a secret...
Hmm... Well, everyone has a secret or two.
With this kind of funding, you could just run this tofu business as a hobby.
N-No!
!? Hey, why are you getting mad all of a sudden?
Ah, I-I'm sorry... It's just...

It's n-not a hobby.
I... no, we are truly serious about selling tofu...
Because I want to succeed in the tofu business with my friends...!
...I can tell how much you want this by the look on your face.
Hmm, in that case...
I'll have to give you some training.
Tr-Training...?

Yeah.
I'll train you so you won't back down to those punks, or even your friends.

o: Where are you?
Where exactly?
Wait, are you behind me?!

chat.t: I got cornered by a salesperson, please help me (；ω；)

o: Gosh, you scared me. I'm on my way.

chat.t: I left the shop completely to my friends today...
And I calculated the sales after coming home...

o: Just think of it as a way to prevent a much bigger deficit.

lines.t: Humanitas Street
I-I left the shop to my friends.
The deficit is probably piling up as we speak...
If the deficit keeps piling up, the shop will go bankrupt...
andiftheshopgoesbankruptmydevastatedfriendswillcausearuckusandendupgoinginandoutofPanoticoneveryday...

Whoa, that's wild speculation.
Just calm down.
B-But at this rate, I'll spend my entire life supporting my friends in prison...!
...Actually, considering their personalities, that does sound plausible.

Right!?
So... l-let's get started! I'm... prepared!

Well, fine.
But... you have to do exactly as I say, deal?
I-I'll do whatever you tell me to!
A moment later

Wh-What?!
I-I absolutely can't do that!

No. You can.
You must.
B-But if something goes wrong... it'll be a huge problem...
Didn't you say you'd do whatever I told you to?
You have to keep your word.
Ugh, urrrgh...
GMO Tofu Club Kitchen
Wow, this is killer.

Look at this milky white flesh.
This is already a work of art.
Would anyone who actually knows tofu be able to resist this?

Are they having a tofu appreciation meeting?
Either way, here's our chance.
I peeked through the window of the GMO Tofu Club to check on the employees.

Suji. The GMO guys are completely distracted by the tofu they made.
Now's our chance!
U-Ugh... can I please not do this?
W-What if this starts another fight...

Stop complaining and do as you're told.
Don't you want to get stronger?
I-I mean, that's true, but...
H-Haa... Haa... N-Now...!
I walked confidently through the front entrance of the GMO Tofu Club with Suji.
U-Um, hello...
Wow. Look how moist the surface of this tofu is.
Hehehe. Our ultimate masterpiece... With this, we're going to write a new chapter in the history of tofu.
Suji, see how they're so obsessed with their tofu that they aren't even paying attention to you?

Let's show them what we've got.
Now, repeat after me.
R-Repeat after me.
No, not that! I meant repeat what I'm about to say.
O-Okay...
I! Am not! A customer!
I-I am not a customer!
Huh? What's this?
Who the hell are you?! This is our turf!
Shut up and listen!
S-Shut up and... listen!
We are... from your rival... 'The Great Tofu Troupe'...!
Special... Agents!

S-Special... a-gents?
But we're not?
Argh, just shut up and follow along!

No, I mean...
*Sigh*.
W-What? The Great Tofu Troupe?
...You mean those guys who sell stuff right in front of the Panoticon?!

Do you have any idea where you are right now?!
Are you here to steal our new product?!

Where did the leak come from?!
Are you spies?! Paparazzi?! Voyeurs?!
...Their vocabulary is getting weirder and weirder.
...Th-Their vocabulary is getting...
Not that! Don't wimp out, just repeat after me!
D-Don't wimp out...! Repeat after me!
This tofu is garbage!
This tofu is... garbage!
W-What did you say?!
This tofu is...

...Anyone can see it has no firmness, releases way too much water, and is dry and crumbly! It lacks any rich, nutty flavor...
And because you sloppily added the coagulant, it hardened unevenly!

This is no different from throwing soybeans straight into the trash!
This tofu is an insult to the very concept of tofu!!

...Taking the initiative before I could even prompt her. I have nothing left to teach.
Magnificent!

H-Huh?!
W-What did I just say...?!
These jerks... barging in out of nowhere and insulting our tofu...!
You didn't think you could just walk away after spitting on our hard work like this, did you?!
You guys are the ones who force-sell tofu to released prisoners right in front of the Panoticon!

Exactly! You shouldn't be complaining to us!
It's obviously just cheap, low-grade tofu anyway!
...What.
What... did... you say? Our tofu is... cheap...? Garbage...?
Huh? Suji, what are you doing with that gun?
...I didn't tell you to do that?!

Our tofu is... cheap?!?!
Take that back right now!!!

W-Whoa, whoa!?
Hey, she's completely snapped!
Whoa, watch out!? Everyone, get down!

The shots fired by Suji completely trashed
the GMO Tofu Club's shop in an instant.
H-Haa... haa...
H-How dare they insult our tofu...
But you're the one who insulted our tofu first...
What did you say?!
N-Nothing, ma'am...

D-Don't think you can get away with provoking The Great Tofu Troupe!
...Please.
...Well, technically, we were the ones who provoked them first.
Anyway! Still! Insulting our Tofu Troupe's tofu is... unforgivable!!
E-Eek!

Hmm!?
Is it the police?!

Y-Yes!
The police are here!
Officer! Over here!
Alright, time to bail!!

...W-What?!!!
W-Wait for me...!
Tofu Street
Whew, that was a satisfying lesson.
...I am never doing this again...

You did great, though.
What was it again? "Your tofu is an abomination that shouldn't exist"?
I-I never said anything like that!
Well, whatever the result... looks like you've gained a bit of courage.
...Y-Yeah... I guess so...?

o: Ready for the next lesson?

chat.t: Can I please have just a little more time...?

o: What is it this time?
Are you trying to back out again?
You get ready on the way.
Just get out here first.
Do you want to come out a year from now instead?
I'll give you 10 minutes.

chat.t: I'll go, just give me 20 minutes!

o: 9 minutes...
Hurry up and get out here instead of typing that.

chat.t: I think I realized something thanks to you.

o: The joy of showing some skin? Or the pleasure of talking down to people?

chat.t: I knew you had a dirty look in your eyes halfway through...

o: It wasn't halfway through. It was from the very beginning.

lines.t: Humanitas Street
I went to our meeting spot, but Suji was nowhere to be found.
{player}, Master...

Did she... run away?
She's not the type to do that...
{player}, Master... I-I'm over here...

Or did she get caught by the police on her way? If so, should I contact the Tofu Troupe and plan a rescue operation...
Actually, she'll be released in a day anyway, so it doesn't really matter.
{player}, Master... Can you hear me...?

Right, there's no way Suji would break a promise.
I can almost hear her voice right now.
{player}, Master!
Whoa!? What the—?!
Suji!? When did you get here?

I've been here since you first arrived.
Hing...
I guess my t-training didn't do anything at all...
Someone like me...
She's slipping back into her self-pity mode...

This won't do.
You need some special training.
S-Special training??
Yeah... training that forces you to expose your true self.

Ex-Expose myself...?
What do you mean by that?
You know, like your face and body.

H-Heek?!
Excuse me, w-where exactly are you looking...?

Why? Is it a crime to look?
Besides, you already stand out enough.
B-But it's embarrassing...

Are you just going to keep hiding forever?
Just like how you hide your expressions behind that mask?
Th-This mask... is my... last... line of defense...
In that case...
That means we can expose everything except your last line of defense, right?
Th-That's...!

Just give it a try.
There are things you can only gain by exposing everything.
...And, you know, it's a real treat for my eyes too.
H-Hing...!

No "hing" allowed.
And formal speech is banned too.
W-What???

If you want to change, you have to change everything.
Steel yourself and give it a shot.
Ah, uh, eh...
Answer me.
Y-Yes...
Are you kidding me? Answer.
O-Okay... I-I got it...
Good. Now change into this!
Humanitas Street
Haa, haa...
I've never had so many eyes on me before today...

By the way, Suji using informal speech isn't bad at all.
It's got a completely different flavor than usual.
Wh-What do you mean by flavor...?

You did great following along.
Looks like you've gained a bit of confidence.
Confidence...?

Yeah.
I mean, you just showed some skin in front of everyone without hesitating, didn't you?
I-Is that what you call confidence?
Of course. The old you would've run away immediately.
I suppose that's true...

You're already growing.
Before you know it, you'll catch up to your friends.

Absolutely.
...As long as you stay with my training until the very end, that is.

chat.t: I don't think I can leave the shop today.
I'm sorry, but I'll have to skip the training.

o: Then I'll just go to you.
Formal speech again?

chat.t: I'm still getting used to... it... Master.
But how should I put it, {player}, you're... how should I say...
I can't quite tell if you're a kind person, or just a pervert...

o: Let's say I'm both.
Oh, you've gotten a lot more comfortable, haven't you? Even clicking your tongue at me.
Nice. Good job.
So, where's my reward?

chat.t: Do I really have to give you a reward... Master?

o: Of course. And keep it informal.
As for the reward... how about a 30-minute lap pillow?

lines.t: Tofu Street
Welcome... Ah!
So you really c-came...
What's with the grim greeting?
But there aren't any customers today, are there?
I don't think people even know the shop is open.
And I still have so much tofu left to sell...
Where's everyone else?
Victoria got arrested because she got into a huge fight with a client who tried to lowball her...
Rona got arrested because she caused a scene when the merchant mixed low-quality ingredients into the supplies for the tofu...
And Kasa got into an argument with an indie band while busking, and she ended up hitting them with her guitar...

What? They all got sent to the Panoticon!?
Are they even trying to run a business?

So I've been watching the shop by myself since this morning...
But I haven't been able to sell a single block of tofu...

I thought I'd changed thanks to our training...
I guess I was just deluding myself...
Hmm...
Why did you start selling tofu in the first place?
Especially when you don't even like tofu that much.
...Because I enjoy being with my friends.
At f-first, I thought they were delinquents, so I kept my distance...

But when I was working on Tofu Street...
Victoria and the others saved me from a terrible customer.
Of course, a fight broke out immediately after that, and we all ended up locked in the Panoticon...
But the day we spent locked up together was actually really fun.
After talking to them, I realized they weren't bad people at all.

So when Victoria asked me to sell tofu with them...
I wanted to stay with them. And...

I also wanted to understand tofu, which my friends love so much...
So I joined them.
Th-That's really all there is to it.
Are you having fun selling tofu now?
...Yes, I am.

Making the tofu, meeting customers, and trading goods...
But above all else.
Being with my friends...
B-But... when things like today happen.

I wonder if I'll ever be able to do this well...
It makes me anxious.
...That's all that matters.
...Huh?
When I first met you, you were a total coward who wanted to back out of everything.

But look at you now.
You're trying your best to handle things even when your friends aren't around.

B-But I still can't sell...
Or handle customers...

That's not the point.
What matters is that 'you' are taking action.
...Is that so...
You don't need training anymore.
So... are you leaving?
What, do you want me to leave?
N-No! Of course not!

Not as a trainer... but I'll help you.
We just need to sell all the tofu here, right?
Y-Yes, please!

...And you're still speaking formally.
I guess our informal speech training had no effect?
Ah, uh...

chat.t: I took your advice and put more effort into selling tofu...!
And amazingly, I sold out all of our tofu today!
I could never have imagined this before.

o: Congratulations.

chat.t: Even the GMO Tofu Club doesn't mess with me when I'm at the shop!

o: Well, of course. You gave them a taste of their own medicine.

chat.t: Thank you. It's all thanks to you.
So, I want to reward you.

o: Care to tell me more about this reward?
Why are you speaking formally again?

chat.t: My heart is still racing... Master.

o: Are you listening to me?

chat.t: I used up all my courage earlier... so the formal speech just keeps slipping out... Master...
It feels awkward if I don't use it...

o: ...Fine, I'll let it slide this once.
But still, to think you'd be so bold when we're alone.
Well, in that case.
I'll always be by your side whenever you need courage.

chat.t: Please take good care of me from now on! {player}!

lines.t: Humanitas Residential Area

{player}...!
Over here.
Where are we?
In front of my neighborhood...
Y-You don't dislike it, do you?
It's not that, so you don't have to shake like that.
Y-Yeah.

But why did you call me here?
It's just a normal neighborhood, a bit plain for a reward...

Yeah.
Y-Yeah, but...
But why are you so nervous?
Y-You just have to listen to me from now on.
Huh?
N-No more excuses, just follow me...!

What the?
Did she suddenly switch characters?
...Well, if this is the result of her training, I guess I should count it as a win...?
Humanitas Residential Area

H-How was it?
Was it fun listening to me today?

Yeah, I feel like I saw a whole new side of you.
You were surprisingly assertive.

Ah! Th-That was...
without even realizing...

Oh, look how red your face is.
Are you flustered already?
Looks like you still need some more training.
R-Really?

I-If it's training from you...
maybe it's not so bad...
Huh? What was that?
Ah, ah! It's nothing!

A-Anyway!
That's all for today!
Maybe it's because she's gained some confidence, but she's gotten faster than before.

Well, I got a nice reward...
I should look forward to the next training session.
